entries.name: ccf-hmac-sha256-suppression-v1
entries.content_token_derivation: content_digest = SHA-256(UTF8(JCS(canonical plaintext semantic payload))) for record-semantic/link-semantic or SHA-256(canonical plaintext Blob bytes) for blob-content; HMAC-SHA-256(key, UTF8('ccf:suppression-content:v1\0') || UTF8(content_class) || 0x00 || raw(content_digest))
entries.scope_commitment_derivation: SHA-256(UTF8('ccf:suppression-scope:v1\0') || UTF8(JCS(scope_object_ids sorted in ascending Unicode code-point order; duplicates preserved)))
entries.entry_order: ascending Unicode code-point order of complete token strings
entries.tree_shape: recursive split at largest power of two smaller than the node count
